data.title: 伽玛 · 平地摔倒前的知性从容
data.action: 端着文件从书桌前款款走来，推着金丝眼镜露出极度干练睿智的笑容，然而脚底高跟拖鞋正踩在睡裙下摆边缘即将摔倒
data.location: 三越商会顶层总裁办公室红木书桌旁
data.lighting: 商会顶层水晶吊灯散发出的奢华暖白光束，照亮知性深蓝真丝高开叉睡裙与丰腴优雅身段
data.mood: 知性干练、大商贾自信、千钧一发平地摔的反差萌
data.description: 富可敌国的三越商会深夜总部。掌控全大陆商业命脉的‘露娜商会会长’伽玛，身穿一件知性深蓝真丝高开叉睡裙，鼻梁上架着金丝细框眼镜。她正仪态万方地端着商会本季度的千亿利润报表走向暗影大人，脸上满是对主上智慧的崇拜与自信的微笑。然而那双天生缺乏平衡感的双脚，拖鞋边缘正狠狠踩住飘逸的睡裙拖尾，整个人重心前倾即将扑倒——「暗影大人！三越商会本季度的全域分红已经核算完毕……呀啊啊啊？！裙、裙子绊住了！暗影大人救我——！」
data.promptProse: Striding across the rug of her lavish Mitsugoshi executive office late at night in a navy-blue heavyweight silk satin wrap nightgown with an empire sash, sweeping side slit, and gold-rimmed glasses, Gamma steps on her own hem and pitches forward in wide-eyed panic as revenue papers fly everywhere beneath the warm crystal chandelier.
data.animaCaption: Stepping gracefully across her lavish executive office in a high-slit navy silk wrap gown and gold-rimmed glasses, she catches her slipper on the trailing hem and pitches forward in sudden panic as ledger sheets scatter through the air. Bright crystal chandelier light catches the flowing satin.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a heavyweight navy-blue silk satin wrap nightgown with an empire waist sash and sweeping high side slit, styled with gold-rimmed glasses and heeled slippers.
